<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the molecular ion (M+H) appears at m/z ≈ 121.05 with an M+1 intensity of ~8 %, indicating a molecule containing about eight carbon atoms. A neutral mass of ~120.04 Da matches the formula C₈H₈O (acetophenone). The SMILES for acetophenone is “CC(=O)C1=CC=CC=C1”. This SMILES is valid and corresponds to the inferred formula.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)C1=CC=CC=C1</final_answer>
